productFit.reason: Sold in the Netherlands as "Primos trigger stick gen 3 schietstok 3-poot" (Mets Jachthuis, Jachtloods).

localFacts.fact: KLM allows hand baggage of max. 55 x 35 x 25 cm; the Summit Carbon II (46 cm), Alpine CF-425 (47 cm) and VEO 3GO (34 cm) fit by length, the Ridgeview (74 cm folded) does not.
CBS: men aged 20 or older in the Netherlands were on average 1,81 m tall in 2018; only the Ridgeview at 187 cm is taller.
Dutch hunting shops sell the Primos Trigger Stick Gen 3 as a "schietstok 3-poot" with a removable 360-degree V rest, so it can also take a camera.
Kamera Express NL lists the Summit Carbon II at 46 x 7,6 cm folded, 1,13 kg and up to 9,98 kg.

localPainPoints.pain: Heavier tripods are steadier in strong wind, but carbon is easier to carry on long walks.
localPainPoints.fix: Carry the light carbon tripod and hang the pack from the hook in wind instead of buying a heavier tripod.

quotes.text: Een hoger gewicht komt de stabiliteit (zeker bij veel wind) altijd iets ten goede.

localPainPoints.pain: A quick-release that is accidentally open can drop the scope.
localPainPoints.fix: Lock the tilt and check the Arca-Swiss clamp before you let go of the optic (setup step 6).

quotes.text: Het belangrijkste bij een snelkoppeling is dat de telescoop er niet vanaf kan vallen als de koppeling toevallig open staat.

localPainPoints.pain: With twist locks you cannot see whether a lock is open or closed.
localPainPoints.fix: Extend the thickest sections first and check each twist lock before you load the tripod; the Primos uses a trigger instead of leg locks.

quotes.text: Nadeel is dat je niet goed ziet of de sluiting los of vast is.
